title: Arena cycle — one champion/challenger evaluation of one slot
description: Emitted every cycle by nousergon_lib.arena.engine.run_cycle for every slot (universe cut, selection producer, model M, strategy S). Carries the full per-arm score ladder, every pairwise verdict with the common window it rests on, the pointer decision with its anytime-valid bound, and every retirement verdict including the ones that did NOT retire and why. Normative source: champion-challenger-policy.md.

benchmark.description: The population an arm is graded against. Default 'population' — the set the arm selected FROM. A selection-stage slot graded against SPY inverts wins and losses (measured 2026-08-17).

config.description: The ArenaConfig parameters in force for THIS cycle, so the decision can be reconstructed from the artifact alone rather than from the config as it stands today (principles.md §2.1) — `promote_evidence` and `promote_min_weeks` in particular change what a given set of comparisons decides. `slot`, `slot_kind` and `benchmark` are deliberately NOT repeated here: they are top-level fields, and a fact emitted twice is a fact that can disagree with itself. ABSENT — as opposed to present — means the document was written before this block existed, which is why it is optional rather than required; same convention as `dimensions` on an arm series.

alpha.description: Two-sided level of the anytime-valid sequence governing PROMOTION.

diff_clip.description: Declared bound on a per-date score DIFFERENCE, in the score's units; the sub-Gaussian scale is derived from it.

min_paired_dates.description: Minimum paired dates before a comparison is attempted at all. NOT a thin-evidence gate.

cap.description: Brian's cap, applied as a RETIREMENT criterion, never as an admission gate.

grace_weeks.description: An arm younger than this is never retired, whatever its ranking.

promote_min_weeks.description: Minimum PAIRED weeks a challenger must share with the incumbent before it can take the pointer (Brian ruling 2026-09-01). A comparison below it stays in `decision.comparisons` with status `measured` and a reason naming the shortfall — never dropped, because a lead that was measured and held back is a fact about the cycle, not an absence.

promote_evidence.description: Evidence bar for SERVING. `anytime_valid` (the policy default, champion-challenger-policy.md §5.0) promotes only a lead the confidence sequence's lower bound supports. `point` promotes the age-eligible challenger with the largest positive mean paired difference, and is a PER-SLOT DECLARED DELTA recorded under §5.2(B) — never a fleet default (Brian ruling 2026-09-12, alpha-engine-config-I10546). The confidence sequence is computed and emitted on every comparison under both modes; under `point` it simply does not decide.

min_active_arms.description: Never retire below this many active arms.

retired_trailing_cycles.description: Cycles a retired arm keeps being scored for past retirement (§3).

retire_evidence.description: Evidence bar for a pairwise loss in the RETIREMENT ranking.

lineage.description: Slot-supplied provenance for THIS arm's series: dimension name -> the distinct values that dimension took across the arm's scored dates. Opaque to the engine, which never reads a key or a value — a `feature_version` field on a contract that also serves U, R and S would make a slot-agnostic engine know about one consumer (principles.md §2.8). The M slot populates `feature_version`; a slot with no upstream version reports `{}`. Distinct VALUES, not a per-date map: the per-date attribution already exists once, in each produce run's manifest `inputs[]`, and the question this surface could not answer was 'did this champion's score series span one feature-layer version or several' (alpha-engine-config-I9903). ABSENT — as opposed to `{}` — means the document was written before the field existed; the two are deliberately distinguishable, which is why this property is optional rather than required.

cycles_present.description: A Condorcet cycle in the pairwise beats-relation. When true, more arms than the cap may carry fewer than `cap` losses and the pool legitimately exceeds the cap for this cycle.

status.description: `unmeasurable` and `unservable` are explicit failure states carrying a reason. An empty comparison never renders as a pass (champion-challenger-policy.md §7.2).

ineligible.description: Arms barred from SERVING by a hard precondition (M-slot behavioural veto, input completeness), regardless of ranking.

retirements.description: One verdict per active arm, INCLUDING the arms that were not retired and the reason each survived. A retirement list containing only retirements cannot be audited.

pair.description: A head-to-head comparison on the two arms' own longest common window. `n_dates` and the window bounds are reported ALONGSIDE the metric — champion-challenger-policy.md §4 requires the intersection be visible, and it was being violated (2026-08-29: an incumbent scored over 2 dates defended against a challenger rejected for having 4).
